templates.name: Complaint Assigned - Email
templates.subject: Complaint #{{complaintNumber}} Assigned to You
templates.htmlBody:
Complaint Assigned

Dear {{assignedToName}},

A complaint has been assigned to you for handling.

Complaint Details:

  • Number: {{complaintNumber}}
  • Title: {{title}}
  • Category: {{categoryName}}
  • Priority: {{priorityName}}
  • Status: {{statusName}}
  • Complainant: {{complainantName}} ({{complainantEmployeeCode}})
  • Due Date: {{dueDate}}

Please review and take appropriate action.

Thank you,
{{companyName}} Support Team

templates.name: Complaint Assigned - SMS
templates.body: {{companyName}}: Complaint #{{complaintNumber}} assigned to you. Priority: {{priorityName}}, Due: {{dueDate}}. Please review.

templates.name: Complaint Assigned - WhatsApp
templates.body: Dear {{assignedToName}}, Complaint #{{complaintNumber}} ({{title}}) assigned to you. Priority: {{priorityName}}, Due: {{dueDate}}. Complainant: {{complainantName}}. Please review. - {{companyName}}

templates.name: Complaint Closed - Email
templates.subject: Complaint #{{complaintNumber}} Closed
templates.htmlBody:
Complaint Closed

Dear {{complainantName}},

Your complaint has been closed.

Complaint Details:

  • Number: {{complaintNumber}}
  • Title: {{title}}
  • Category: {{categoryName}}
  • Closed By: {{closedBy}}
  • Closed Date: {{closedDate}}
  • Resolution: {{resolution}}

If you have any further concerns, please feel free to reopen this complaint or submit a new one.

Thank you,
{{companyName}} Support Team

templates.name: Complaint Closed - SMS
templates.body: {{companyName}}: Your complaint #{{complaintNumber}} has been closed. Resolution: {{resolution}}. Thank you.

templates.name: Complaint Closed - WhatsApp
templates.body: Dear {{complainantName}}, Your complaint #{{complaintNumber}} ({{title}}) has been closed. Closed by: {{closedBy}}. Resolution: {{resolution}}. Thank you! - {{companyName}}

templates.name: Complaint Created - Email
templates.description: Email template for new complaint creation
templates.subject: Complaint #{{complaintNumber}} Created - {{title}}
templates.htmlBody:
Complaint Created

Dear {{complainantName}},

Your complaint has been successfully submitted.

Complaint Details:

  • Number: {{complaintNumber}}
  • Title: {{title}}
  • Category: {{categoryName}}
  • Priority: {{priorityName}}
  • Status: {{statusName}}
  • Submitted: {{createdDate}}

We will review your complaint and assign it to an appropriate handler soon.

Thank you,
{{companyName}} Support Team

templates.name: Complaint Created - SMS
templates.description: SMS template for new complaint creation
templates.body: {{companyName}}: Your complaint #{{complaintNumber}} has been submitted. Category: {{categoryName}}, Priority: {{priorityName}}. We will review shortly.

templates.name: Complaint Created - WhatsApp
templates.description: WhatsApp template for new complaint creation
templates.body: Dear {{complainantName}}, Your complaint #{{complaintNumber}} ({{title}}) has been submitted. Category: {{categoryName}}, Priority: {{priorityName}}. We will review soon. - {{companyName}}

templates.name: Complaint Escalated - Email
templates.subject: Complaint #{{complaintNumber}} Escalated to Level {{escalationLevel}}
templates.htmlBody:
Complaint Escalated

Dear {{escalatedTo}},

A complaint has been escalated to your level for resolution.

Complaint Details:

  • Number: {{complaintNumber}}
  • Title: {{title}}
  • Category: {{categoryName}}
  • Priority: {{priorityName}}
  • Escalation Level: {{escalationLevel}}
  • Reason: {{escalationReason}}
  • Complainant: {{complainantName}}

This requires urgent attention. Please review and take appropriate action.

Thank you,
{{companyName}} Support Team

templates.name: Complaint Escalated - SMS
templates.body: URGENT: Complaint #{{complaintNumber}} escalated to Level {{escalationLevel}}. Reason: {{escalationReason}}. Please take immediate action. - {{companyName}}

templates.name: Complaint Escalated - WhatsApp
templates.body: URGENT! Dear {{escalatedTo}}, Complaint #{{complaintNumber}} escalated to Level {{escalationLevel}}. Reason: {{escalationReason}}. Priority: {{priorityName}}. Requires immediate attention! - {{companyName}}

templates.name: Complaint Overdue - Email
templates.description: Email template for overdue complaint alert
templates.subject: URGENT: Complaint #{{complaintNumber}} is Overdue
templates.htmlBody:
URGENT: Complaint Overdue

Dear {{assignedToName}},

Complaint #{{complaintNumber}} is now overdue.

Complaint Details:

  • Number: {{complaintNumber}}
  • Title: {{title}}
  • Priority: {{priorityName}}
  • Due Date: {{dueDate}}
  • Days Overdue: {{daysOverdue}}

Please take immediate action to resolve this complaint.

Thank you,
{{companyName}} Support Team

templates.name: Complaint Overdue - SMS
templates.description: SMS template for overdue complaint alert
templates.body: URGENT: Complaint #{{complaintNumber}} is {{daysOverdue}} days overdue. Due: {{dueDate}}. Please resolve immediately. - {{companyName}}

templates.name: Complaint Overdue - WhatsApp
templates.description: WhatsApp template for overdue complaint alert
templates.body: URGENT! Dear {{assignedToName}}, Complaint #{{complaintNumber}} is {{daysOverdue}} days OVERDUE! Due: {{dueDate}}, Priority: {{priorityName}}. Please resolve immediately! - {{companyName}}
